name: Skeleton Waiting At Computer
look: A photo of an anatomical skeleton seated at an office desk, wearing a headset, one bony hand on the mouse and the other raised to its chest. It faces a computer monitor and keyboard beside a blue desk lamp and a green water bottle, with a coworker standing behind.
use: Means waiting so long you turned into a skeleton. Captions describe a slow computer, a long hold time, a reply that never comes or a support ticket stuck in a queue, usually with a work or tech theme.
slots: top caption: what you are waiting for
bottom caption: how long it has been (optional)
examples: Waiting for IT to answer my ticket
Me on hold with customer service
Your call is important to us
describe: skeleton sitting at a computer desk with a headset
skeleton at work still waiting at the office
bones guy using a mouse in front of a monitor
